name: World of Warcraft (Retail)
hint: Choose World of Warcraft in Battle.net.

name: World of Warcraft Forever
hint: Choose Forever, or Forever Beta under In Development while testing. Folder names can change; confirm the client.

name: Classic Era / Hardcore / Season of Discovery
hint: Choose Classic Era. Select an available Hardcore or Season of Discovery realm inside the game. This is one client tile, not a realm selector.

name: Classic Progression
hint: Choose the current progression expansion in Battle.net. The expansion name changes over time.

name: Classic Anniversary
hint: Choose the Anniversary product offered by Battle.net. If it shares a client with another edition, register that executable once; do not assume a dedicated folder exists.

name: Retail PTR
hint: Choose the appropriate PTR under In Development. Access and availability are controlled by Blizzard.

name: Retail Beta
hint: Choose the current beta under In Development. Beta access is required.

name: Classic PTR / Beta
hint: Choose the intended Classic test product. _classic_beta_ is reused across tests; it may currently contain Forever. Verify before registering.

name: Other / future WoW client
hint: Select the official client in Battle.net, then provide its installed game executable. No hard-coded product code is required.
